library.title: Library
library.pick_title: Choose the folder where you keep your manga
library.pick_body: Each folder inside becomes a collection, and its PDF, CBR and CBZ files are the volumes. Hakufu only reads it: it never copies, moves or deletes anything.
library.empty_body: Create a folder for each series inside your library folder, put your PDF, CBR or CBZ volumes in it and click “Refresh”.
library.empty_body_ios: Open the Files app, go to “On My iPhone/iPad → Hakufu”, create a folder for each series and put your PDF, CBR or CBZ volumes in it. Then come back and tap “Refresh”.
library.scan_no_root: Choose the folder where you keep your manga.
library.scan_unreadable: Can't read the folder “{0}”. Is the drive connected, or has it moved?
library.scan_empty_folder: The folder “{0}” is empty. If it's on a drive, is it connected? Until then, the library stays as it was.
library.clear_confirm: Hakufu will forget {0} from this folder, with their progress and favorites. Empty the library?
library.empty_body_android: Copy your manga into the library folder (by default, "Hakufu" in internal storage) from your PC over USB or with any file manager: one folder per series with its PDF, CBR or CBZ files. Then come back and tap "Refresh".
library.folder_not_on_device: That folder isn't on the phone (Drive and the like won't work). Choose one in internal storage or on the SD card.
library.permission_title: Hakufu needs to see your manga
library.permission_body: To read your library folder, Android asks for the "All files access" permission. Hakufu only reads: it never copies, moves or deletes anything, and it doesn't use the internet except to tell you about new versions.
